status: development copy; not yet a published release
built_by: cerium_bump src/dwarf_vice/observations.py::build_samples (H21 Table-2 IDs joined to allStarLite-dr17-synspec_rev1.fits; unique EXTRATARG bit-4-clear observation per ID)
known_issues: GSE Table 2 has 1823 rows vs 972 in H21 Table 1
11 IDs are in both GSE and Sgr

h21_grid_flexce.npz.source: prototypes/h21_vice/run_grid.py flexce + pack_grid.py: same 3403 models in flexCE 2450aa29 via chemical_evolution gce_tools.flexce_h21 (commit 76acf11), 30 Myr steps; same keys as h21_grid_vice.npz but time (400,) and tracks (3403, 400) float32

h21_grid_scores.csv.source: prototypes/h21_vice/score_grid.py: chi2_track + chi2_endpoint per model and engine against the *_h21.ecsv samples

h21_grid_vice.npz.source: prototypes/h21_vice/run_grid.py vice + pack_grid.py: full H21 Table-4 grid (3403 models: LMC 625, SMC 750, Sgr 625, GSE 143, Fornax 1260), VICE 1.3.1, dt 0.03 Gyr, 12 Gyr; keys galaxy, sfe0, eta, tau_i, tau_b, sigma_b, f_b (NaN = unused), time (401,), sfr/mgas/feh/sife/mgfe (3403, 401) float32; chi2 matches cerium_bump h21_matched_dt0.03.csv to 1.2e-7

h21_ssp_bundle.npz.source: cerium_bump results/yields/h21_ssp_bundle.npz (built by src/dwarf_vice/yields.py::build_bundle from public flexCE 2450aa29 yields: LC06/CL04 CCSN, Karakas10 AGB, Iwamoto99 W70 SN Ia; validation in cerium_bump results/yields/h21_yield_validation.json)
